title: Blockula node
description: One Blockula validator, sentry or RPC node and its host. Metrics: node/src/api.rs /metrics and node_exporter.

panels.title: Executed height
panels.description: Height of the newest block this node has executed.

panels.title: Finalized height
panels.description: Highest height with a finalization certificate this node knows of.

panels.title: Head age
panels.description: Seconds since the executed head's timestamp. Blocks are 1 s; /api/health fails past 10 s.

panels.title: Execution lag
panels.description: Finalized minus executed height, in blocks. Past MAX_EXEC_LAG (16) this validator's proposals are invalid.

panels.title: Epoch
panels.description: Current epoch (the validator set changes only at epoch boundaries).

panels.title: Mempool
panels.description: Pending transactions. The node refuses new ones at MAX_MEMPOOL (5,000).

panels.title: Blocks per minute
panels.description: Executed blocks per minute. With 1 s blocks a healthy chain shows about 60.

panels.title: Head age
panels.description: Seconds since the executed head's timestamp. The dashed line is the /api/health limit (10 s).

panels.title: Execution lag
panels.description: Finalized minus executed height (blocks). The dashed line is MAX_EXEC_LAG (16).

panels.title: Mempool
panels.description: Pending transactions. The dashed line is the cap, MAX_MEMPOOL (5,000).

panels.title: Transactions over HTTP
panels.description: Transactions submitted to this node's /api/tx per second (5 min average).

panels.title: Faucet drips
panels.description: Faucet drips per hour (test chains only; mainnet has no faucet).

panels.title: Active validators
panels.description: Validators in this epoch's active set.

panels.title: Quorum
panels.description: Votes a certificate needs: n − ⌊(n−1)/3⌋.

panels.title: Signers on the newest certificate
panels.description: Signers on the newest finalization certificate. Certificates stop collecting at a quorum, so this is a lower bound on who is online, not a census.

panels.title: Versions
panels.description: blockula version and git sha per node (blockula_build_info).

panels.title: Certificate signers vs quorum
panels.description: Signers on the newest certificate against the quorum and the active set. Signers at quorum is normal (certificates stop there); a halt shows up as a stale head, not here.

panels.title: P2P peers
panels.description: Connected p2p peers (validators). BlockulaFewPeers fires below quorum − 1: this node's votes may not reach enough of the set.

panels.title: Missed leader slots
panels.description: Leader slots each active validator missed in its downtime window (MAINNET-DESIGN 3.4). Past blockula_downtime_max_missed it's jailed; BlockulaValidatorMissingSlots warns at half of it for this node's validator (own="1").

panels.title: Jailed / tombstoned
panels.description: This node's validator (own="1"): jailed (left the set, unjail after jail_blocks) or tombstoned (double-signed, out for good). Both page.

panels.title: Slashing protection
panels.description: Newest view this validator's key signed in the current epoch (from the record next to validator.key; views restart each epoch), and 1 while it watches the network after a start. A drop within an epoch means the record went backwards: BlockulaSlashingProtectionRolledBack.

panels.title: Protocol version
panels.description: Version in force at the next height (upgrade.rs). Blocks carry it; verifiers reject any other.

panels.title: Binary supports
panels.description: Newest protocol version this node's binary runs; its proposals signal it (/api/upgrade shows the set's readiness).

panels.title: Blocks to next upgrade
panels.description: Blocks until the next scheduled protocol version activates (none scheduled: no value). BlockulaUpgradeRequired fires if this binary doesn't run it.

panels.title: Halted
panels.description: 1 when the node stopped executing on purpose (--halt-height, or a version its binary doesn't run). /api/health says why.

panels.title: Memory available
panels.description: Share of memory available. The alert fires below 10%.

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: Used share per filesystem. Alerts at 80% and 90%; size volumes with docs/OPERATIONS.md "Disk sizing".

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Bytes per second. Certificates dominate a validator's egress: about 4.5 MB/s at 32 validators (docs/OPERATIONS.md "Bandwidth").

panels.title: Clock offset (absolute)
panels.description: Distance from NTP time (node_exporter timex). Verifiers reject blocks more than 1 s ahead of their clock; alerts fire past 100 ms and 250 ms.
